name: Southwind Village
summary: In Southwind Village, fallen defenders haunt the ruins beneath Silithus’s sands. The qiraji destroyed the night elf outpost during the War of the Shifting Sands, and silithid still prowl the dunes.

sections.title: A Tragedy in the Sands
sections.body: During the War of the Shifting Sands, a thousand years ago, Southwind Village held a night elf stronghold. When qiraji legions broke through its defenses, Valstann Staghelm led a detachment to hold the village. He was the son of Archdruid Fandral Staghelm. The defenders were overwhelmed and slaughtered, and General Rajaxx dragged Valstann away into captivity. The village lay in ruins, its buildings fractured beneath the sun.

sections.title: The Tormented Dead
sections.body: A thousand years after the fall, Southwind Village still bears the marks of the assault. The slain night elf Sentinels and druids could not move on. Driven mad by the horror of their final moments, their spirits roam the crumbled stone walls without end, led by the Shade of Ambermoon. They lash out at anyone who enters, while predatory silithid swarm across the surrounding dunes.

faq.answer: The qiraji destroyed Southwind Village during the War of the Shifting Sands a thousand years ago. Their army overwhelmed the night elf garrison, slaughtered its defenders, and ruined the outpost.

Valstann Staghelm was the beloved son of Archdruid Fandral Staghelm. He led Southwind Village’s defense against the invading qiraji, but his troops were overwhelmed and General Rajaxx dragged him away into captivity.

faq.q: Why are there night elf ghosts here?
aliases: why are there ghosts in southwind
faq.answer: The brutal slaughter trapped the spirits of Southwind Village’s slain druids and Sentinels in the ruins. They remain caught in an endless loop of their final battle, with the Shade of Ambermoon among them.

faq.q: Are the bugs related to what destroyed the village?
faq.answer: Yes. Silithid swarm around the ruins as part of the wider insectoid force tied to the qiraji, who invaded Silithus and destroyed the outpost.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Southwind Village as one of your people’s most painful defeats. Its tortured specters are fellow kaldorei, still awaiting peace.
As a druid, you see the ruined grove-like structures and tormented spirits of ancient druids in Southwind. They recall nature’s loss against the insectoid hordes.
